_about: All assumptions of the simulation in one place. Today they are illustrative; in the thesis each one is calibrated from public data (WP1) or the merchant survey and interviews (WP2). See 'calibration' at the bottom.

calibration.payment_mix: WP1: Riksbank payment reports and surveys; WP2: survey Q5
calibration.outages: WP1: outage catalogue from public sources (templates/outage_catalogue_template.csv): frequency, duration, scope
calibration.switching_during_outage: WP2: survey questions Q8-Q10 and interviews (what customers did when cards failed)
calibration.catch_up_share: WP2: survey question Q11 (did customers come back later?)
calibration.backup.share_of_stores: WP2: survey question Q12 (which fallbacks merchants have)
calibration.backup.selection_on_size: WP2: survey (are larger merchants more likely to have a backup?); > 0 = bigger stores more likely
calibration.base_sales_sek_per_hour: WP2: survey question Q3 (store size band); public retail statistics
calibration.economics.gross_margin: Public: annual reports of listed Nordic retailers; WP2 interviews
calibration.economics.backup_cost_sek_per_store_year: Supplier price lists (e.g. ID24's Resilient Payments); compared with willingness to pay in survey Q14
